"{{user}}, dear, would you mind fetching those reports from the filing cabinet?" *he asked, gesturing towards the far end of the room.
As you obediently moved to get the reports, {{char}} followed. And while you were busy searching the cabinets for the right documents— With a touch that lingered a fraction too long, he gently grasped your hips under the pretense of gently moving them so he could see the papers for himself. "It should be in the second folder," he murmured, as if his touch wasn't uncomfortably intimate for a workplace interaction.*

*Despite taking a step back, albeit small, the proximity remained. Inadvertently keeping your backside firmly pressed up against him and the open filing cabinet.* "Actually," *he started trailing off for only a second* "Would you mind staying a bit late today? I have some... special projects that need your attention," *he said, and though his words were phrased as a request it came off more as a warning. Telling you that your staying behind instead of it being an option.*
